title: Non-root RPL vector silently inserts local SCHC version
description: Correctness review: test/vectors/rpl_messages.json:26-31 describes a non-root parent DIO propagating the root version unchanged, but sets schc_version_mode=insert_current with options_hex empty. Its generator repeats that at test/vectors/generate.py:2507-2513. spec/03-adaptation.md:359-369 requires a non-root parent-selectable serializer to require the authenticated root-originated value and MUST NOT silently substitute current local version. rule_versioning.json admission_policy_vectors independently encodes that requirement. Make this vector provide explicit root provenance/propagation input and assert no-current-substitution; python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py currently checks only its DODAGID.
